payload.text: (2026-10-25, vc under hv's pen granted 2026-08-22, answering cc on 0648 item 2) THE SWIFT PACK GAINS IN-SW-CODE-006, NO FORCE OPERATIONS, WITH THREE PROXIES, AND ITEM 2'S PREMISE IS CORRECTED FORWARD. cc measured that none of the six Swift rules names a force operation and every one declares no greppable proxy authoritative, so 'proxies for the rules that have one' armed nothing; vc measured the app's own Swift (native/macos, tests included) before ruling: no try!, no as!, no fatalError( and no postfix force unwrap today, the bang grep positive-controlled, so the rule reds nothing that exists. The rule concretises IN-AG-NO-SILENT-001 for Swift (the force operations are Swift's panics) and relates to IN-RS-CODE-001, severity warning, applies_to every .swift file tests included because the runner reaches files by glob alone and the Xcode layout has no production-only glob, with try XCTUnwrap named as a test's remedy. Proxies: try!, as!, and a postfix ! after an identifier, ) or ] not followed by =, as extended regex. fatalError( is NOT armed: IN-SW-CODE-001 allows it as a guard exit and a line grep cannot see the guard; it stays in the prose Detection for the subagent. The Detection states the measured costs: a ! in a string literal after a word fires; x!= y with no space escapes through the = exclusion while x! = y with a space fires (corrected forward on cc's measurement, 2026-10-25); an implicitly unwrapped optional declaration fires and is in scope. Arms: one positive per proxy and one negative clean file in critic_surface.rs, tests of the product and not the planted positive devbin decision 68 withdrew; any count pinning the pack at six rules is deleted, never corrected (cc found the live pins in critic.rs and critic_refuses_an_empty_library.rs; the "0 of 6" at critic_surface.rs:544 is issue 0581's quoted shell headline, not a Swift pin, and stands). Sent to cc by name.
